rulesStrings.li: questDescription->Scattered biological evidence suggests that several known Wraith sites form one lineage of technology rather than isolated ruins. Follow the trail physically from a ruined feeding laboratory through abandoned cloning infrastructure to a mature Hive.

questDescription->Replicator evidence links consumed technological ruins, concealed human-form operatives and sovereign continuity. Investigate the real sites and resolve the exact infiltrator before following the pattern to the Queen vault.

questDescription->Precursor field records connect an open laboratory, a sealed Ancient vault and a later dormant Asuran installation. Follow the sites in person and reconstruct the history without receiving free endgame technology.

questDescription->With the Wraith, Replicator and Ancient/Asuran field trails complete, their records can finally be compared as intersecting histories. The technologies remain distinct; the convergence is evidence, not a free research or artifact reward.
